description: As the Operations Manager overseeing a manufacturing company's office consolidation, the London Office is being permanently closed effective March 2025. All hardware assets currently assigned to the London Office location must be transferred to the New York Office. Any assets that are currently checked out to London-based employees must first be checked in, then have their default location updated to 'New York Office'. For each relocated asset, append the note 'RELOCATED: London Office closure - transferred to NYC per directive OM-2025-031'. Additionally, create two new assets at the New York Office to replace shared London equipment: (1) Asset tag 'ASSET-D004', name 'Dell OptiPlex 7010 - NYC Expansion', model 'Dell OptiPlex 7010', status 'Ready to Deploy', serial 'DOPT7010-NYC-EXP1', purchase cost $899.99, warranty 36 months, purchase date '2025-03-01'; (2) Asset tag 'ASSET-M004', name 'Dell U2723QE Monitor - NYC Expansion', model 'Dell U2723QE 27in 4K', status 'Ready to Deploy', serial 'DMON-NYC-EXP1', purchase cost $549.99, warranty 36 months, purchase date '2025-03-01'.
